verdict.rationale: vLLM's official docs explicitly list support for x86, ARM, and PowerPC CPUs, which directly covers the story's PowerPC example. That support rests on a single feature-list line with no supporting detail. Missing for 10: PowerPC-specific install/build documentation, evidence of other non-x86/ARM CPU architectures beyond PowerPC, performance or feature-parity details for PowerPC, independent or hands-on corroboration.
